articles.title: Ahsan: The Man, The Myth, The Missed Messages
articles.description: A comedy-intro article roasting Ahsan, the guy who thinks he’s irresistible but gets treated like a “Seen Only” notification by the universe.
articles.author: Saad

content.text: Meet Ahsan — A Walking Red Flag in HD

Meet Ahsan, a guy who genuinely believes he’s the final boss of attractiveness just because he fixes his hair every 12 seconds. He enters a room like girls were waiting for him… but the only thing waiting is silence. His confidence is strong, but reality always slaps it back into factory settings.
The Man, The Myth, The Delusion

Ahsan’s biggest dream is girls replying fast, but even dreams have limits. His DMs look like a graveyard — quiet, empty, and full of unanswered hopes. He sends “hi” with the same energy as a proposal, and still gets ignored like a Terms & Conditions page. His friends call him consistent; others call it clown behavior.

Every day, Ahsan wakes up ready to risk his dignity again, retyping messages that will never see a reply. He treats every girl like royalty, but life treats him like a free trial version. Even WiFi signals are more stable than his chances. And yet… he never quits. Because delusion? Unlimited. Free trial? Forever.
Ahsan doesn’t get rejected — the universe just saves him from embarrassing himself twice.
content.author: Rayyan Hassan
